layout: Light bg (#F8FAFC). Header 'Payment' with back arrow. Split: payment methods on top, summary + CTA on bottom. Mobile: stacked.
elements: HEADER: 'Payment' title (navy h2), back arrow left, security badge 'Secured by Xendit' right
PAYMENT METHODS: Section title 'Choose payment method'
Grid of large selection cards (2 columns desktop, 1 column mobile). Each card:
- Payment icon (GoPay green, OVO purple, DANA blue, QRIS, Bank Transfer)
- Payment name (GoPay, OVO, DANA, QRIS, Bank Transfer)
- Radio indicator circle. Selected: orange (#FF8A34) border + filled dot. Unselected: gray border
- Optional: promo badge (e.g. 'Diskon 10%' for certain methods)
BOOKING SUMMARY: Compact card below methods
Buddy name, date, time, location, package type. Small slate text, 14px
CTA: 'Pay Rp 150.000' — orange (#FF8A34), full width, large
PROCESSING STATE: Full-screen overlay with spinner, 'Processing payment...'
SUCCESS STATE: Green checkmark circle animation, 'Payment Successful!'
ERROR STATE: Red alert box, 'Payment failed. Try again.' + retry button
notes: Large payment cards with clear icons. Xendit security badge for trust. Processing state max 3 seconds. Success state feels celebratory.
